title: CI supply chain and workflow gates
goal: Every workflow is SHA-pinned, least-privileged, strict-shell and blocking; Zizmor blocks; a Pest gate with negative fixtures prevents regressions; the root lock makes qualification reproducible.
context: Audit P0-B (A02, A03), P1 A10, P2 A12 and the required-check naming needed by P0-A. Work on branch feat/1.0-final-hardening (D5). Inputs: knowledge/supply-chain, knowledge/execution.
pitfalls: Annotated-tag SHAs instead of commit SHAs break actions
Aggregate jobs without if: always() are skipped and count as success
paths filters leave required checks pending
deliverables: Hardened, pinned, blocking workflows with an executable hardening gate
